title: Understanding Model Risk
text: Model risk is the sum of bias squared, variance, and observational variance. Can you use this information to find the bias squared for the initial model?

title: Calculate Initial Bias Squared
text: Given the initial model risk is $$32$$, model variance is $$8$$, and observational variance is $$3$$, calculate the bias squared.

title: New Model Risk
text: The new model risk is $$17$$. How does this affect the bias squared, variance, and observational variance?

title: Calculate New Bias Squared
text: With the new model risk of $$17$$, model variance of $$15$$, and observational variance of $$3$$, calculate the new bias squared.

title: Interpreting Negative Bias Squared
text: A negative bias squared is not possible. What does this imply about the assumptions or calculations?

title: Re-evaluating Model Variance
text: If the bias squared cannot be negative, consider if the model variance or observational variance might have been miscalculated or changed.
